Key.English: Disabling this setting will prevent seizures from occuring
Key.Spanish: Desactivar este ajuste hará que no ocurran ataques de convulsiones

Key.English: Avoid setting this higher than Max Duration or expect incorrect behaviour
Key.Spanish: Es recomendable que no sea mayor que la duración máxima para evitar comportamiento incorrecto

Key.English: Avoid setting this lower than Max Duration or expect incorrect behaviour
Key.Spanish: Es recomendable que no sea inferior a la duración mínima para evitar comportamiento incorrecto
